summary: Dellia Group ASA, through its subsidiaries, operates as a branded consumer goods company in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Iceland, the United Kingdom, Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, Switzerland, Portugal, Spain, and China. The company offers dried fruit products under the Sunshine Delights brand name; chocolate-dipped dried fruits under the Dippies brand name; and flavored dates under the A date with brand name, as well as private label dietary food supplements. It exports its products. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Oslo, Norway.
